title: Lay a star fire
kid_text: Point big sticks at the coals.
safety: Pull the logs apart before you walk away.

steps.text: Let a small bed of coals form.
Point four thick logs at that bed.
Leave a gap between the log ends.
Push a log in when its end burns.
Pull the logs apart if you leave.

mistakes.text: The log ends touch and smother the coals.
mistakes.fix: Leave a small gap for air.

mistakes.text: You walk off with the logs still in.
